question: Is the lens proven?
answer_md:
On 26 held-out pull requests the lens never saw, Keeper recovered 31% of what the maintainer raised, against 31% for generic review: a difference of -1% (90% interval -18% to 16%) [[metric:recall_difference]]. The test **did not pass** [[metric:overall]].
Criteria not met: Keeper recovers more than generic review (interval above zero); No exaggeration (top-category ratio ≤ 1.3, category spread no worse).
